title: Cold rebuild: Replace the primitive
summary: Rebuild Replace the primitive from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Replace the primitive** in *Parameter objects and primitive obsession*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.title: Rebuild Replace the primitive cold
prompt: Emails are `string`s, checked (or not) all over the place. Write `readonly record struct Email`:
- constructor `Email(string value)`: trims, lower-cases, and throws `ArgumentException` unless there is exactly one `@` with text on both sides
- `string Value { get; }`, `string Domain` (the part after `@`), and `ToString()` returning `Value`
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
Type the shape yourself, then fill it in:
